ei.title: Chapter 5-16 2번: Identity Consistency vs. Positive Feelings
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: The discovery that identities change the way we seek information raises interesting questions. For example, there is ample evidence that people try to make themselves look good in many situations. In contrast, researchers also found that people seek out negative information about themselves if it supports a negative identity. How is it that a person wants to make herself look good, while at the same time she wants to make herself look bad? Some researchers proposed that people try to obtain information that is consistent with their identities, whether they think of themselves positively or negatively. That is, people seek information that seems to them to be true, even if that information is negative about themselves. In contrast, positive information makes people feel good, whether it is consistent with their identity or not. Emotionally, people want to look as good as possible.

det.korean: 흥미로운(interesting) 의문을 제기하고(raises), 풍부한 증거(evidence)가 있다.

❌ ④ doubt (C 반대: 증거→의심)

det.korean: 풍부한(ample) 증거, 부정적 정체성을 뒷받침하면(supports), 일치하는 정보를 얻으려(obtain) 함.

❌ ② scarce (A 반대: 풍부한→부족한)

questions.passage: The discovery that identities change the way we seek information raises interesting questions. In contrast, researchers also found that people seek out negative information about themselves if it supports a negative identity. How is it that a person wants to make herself look good, while at the same time she wants to make herself look bad? Some researchers proposed that people try to obtain information that is (A)[conflicting / consistent] with their identities, whether they think of themselves positively or negatively. That is, people seek information that seems to them to be (B)[false / true], even if that information is negative about themselves. In contrast, positive information makes people feel good, whether it is consistent with their identity or not. Emotionally, people want to look as good as (C)[possible / unlikely].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 정체성과 일치하는(consistent), 사실로(true) 보이는 정보를 찾으며, 가능한(possible) 한 좋게 보이려 함.

❌ ② false (B 반대: 사실인→거짓인)
